"Killing without unleashing power"――that doesn't make sense.
m300416.なんだっていいですけど、\nコマ回しで村がだいぶ荒れたので、\n直さないとまずい:
That's up to you, but
the top-spinning match caused quite a bit of damage to the village,
so we need to fix it before things get worse.
m300416.のんのん、今は政務官じゃなくて、\nあ・い・ど・る♪ アンナでしょ？:
Nononon, I'm not the Chief of Staff right now,
I'm an i-d-o-l♪ Anna, okay?
m300416.はい、進んで進んでーっと、\nおや？ これは……。: Yes, keep moving, keep moving—— Huh? This is…….
m300416.はい。あれは確か、\n魔王軍で前線指揮官をしていたグレーターデーモンです。\n王:
No. That one is a Greater Demon,
who served as a frontline commander in the Demon King's army.
I don't think he has any experience fighting the Royal Army.
m300416.はふはふっ……！\nん～っ、おいしいですの！ みんなで作ったお鍋！:
Hah, hah...!
Mmm~! It's delicious! This hot pot we all made!
m300416.はーい、次はこの２列、立ち上がってくださーい。\n押さないでー、焦らないでー。\: Alright, the next two rows, please stand up. Don't push, don't rush. Keep Anna-chan in your hearts, okay?
m300416.はー重たい重たい。\n倉庫の地雷を一気に運び出せとは無理を言うぜ。:
Haa, it's heavy, heavy.
Telling me to haul all the mines out of the storage at once is a bit much.
m300416.ひとつだけ訊きたい。\nきみは何故、そんなことをしたんだい？:
I just have one question.
Why did you do such a thing?
m300416.ひとりぼっちの時期が長かったの、料理くらいできるわ。\n死んだ彼とは、せいぜい知:
I spent a long time on my own, so I know how to cook.
I was only casual acquaintances with the deceased.
We just occasionally shared tea or a blanket.
m300416.ひどい……。頑張って作った料理に、\n変なものを混ぜるだなんて。:
How awful... To mix something strange
into a dish that was made with such care.
m300416.ふ……ふぅ……終わりました？\n終わりました……よね？:
Phew… phew… Is it over?
It's over… right?
m300416.ふぅ、悪夢はどうにか片付きましたね。: Phew, we managed to deal with the nightmare.
m300416.ふぇっ、なに！？\n敵襲！？ ガリウスでも復活した！？:
Wha?!
An enemy attack?! Did Garius come back to life?!
m300416.ふぉっふぉっふぉ、先を越されてしまったか。\nそれでは本年の戦初め――総員、戦闘:
Ho ho ho, beaten to the punch, am I?
Then let this be the first battle of the year—everyone, engage!
m300416.ふたりに悪意はなさそうです。\nあのコマさえ止めれば、被害は収まるでしょう。:
They don't seem to have any ill intent.
If we can just stop those tops, the damage should be contained.
m300416.ふふっ、きっと大切なものでしょうに。\nアンナさんも罪な女、ですね？:
Heh, it must be very precious to them.
Anna really is a lucky girl, isn't she?
m300416.ふふっ、アヅミが吟味に吟味を重ねた食材たち――\nを旦那様に振舞った余りと、ここ:
Hehe, these are ingredients I carefully selected and prepared――
leftovers from what I served my husband, combined with wild greens gathered right here,
to make a mountain-yamauba-style mixed hot pot.
m300416.ふふっ。では私も。: Hehe. Then I will as well.
m300416.ふふん、アイドルは勝ち負けじゃないよ？\nあたしたちも、もっともっと輝こうね♪:
Pfft, idols aren't about winning or losing, you know?
Let's all shine even brighter♪
m300416.ふわぁぁ……アンナちゃん可愛い！\n兵士の人たちもかっこいいなぁ……。: Whew…… Anna-chan is so cute! The soldiers look cool, too…….
m300416.ふん、まあまあの味じゃない……あつっ……。\n食材を切ったのが私だものね……あづ:
Hmph, it's not bad, I suppose... ow....
I'm the one who cut the ingredients... ow...
m300416.へぇ、私が犯人だと言うの？\nでは聞かせてみなさい、その推理を。:
Hm, so I'm the culprit, are I?
Then do tell. I'd love to hear your deduction.
m300416.ほ、ほら、そろそろ夢から出ますよ！\nえーっと……王子、いい夢みてくださいね！:
H-Hey, we should be waking up from the dream soon!
Um... Prince, please have a good dream!
m300416.ほう、魔王軍にいた頃、コマでブイブイ言わせてきた、\nこのワシに挑むとは……面白:
Hm. Back when I served the Demon King, I was the undisputed king of top-spinning.
You dare challenge me... How entertaining.
m300416.ほら。落ちる場所に影が映る。\nお陰である程度の落下地は予測できるはずだ。\n王:
Look. You can see their shadows on the floor.
That should let us predict where they'll land.
Prince, watch the floor carefully.
m300416.ほんとに苦しみなく逝けたのなら、\nせめて、せめて、それだけは救いですの。:
If she truly passed away without suffering,
then at least, at least, that is some comfort.
m300416.ぼくは名探偵アナベラ。騒ぎを聞いて駆け付けたんだ。\nこれより検死を行う――皆は:
I am Detective Anabella. I heard the commotion and came running.
I will now perform an autopsy—please, no one move from here.
m300416.まさか、ワシの自慢のコマが破壊されるとはね……。: To think my prized top would be destroyed...
m300416.まったく、正月から騒がしい……。\nなにを騒いでいるというのかな？:
For goodness' sake, it's so noisy on New Year's...
What is all the commotion about?
m300416.まったく、騒がしいお正月ですね……。: Honestly, what a noisy New Year's...
m300416.み、みなさーん！\n王子の夢の中の、王国軍のみなさーん！！\nたーすーけーてーく:
E-everyone!
The Royal Army in the Prince's dream!
P-Please h-help us!!
m300416.みなさーん。年越しそばの準備ができましたよ。\n食堂へいらしてください。:
Everyone. The New Year's soba is ready.
Please come to the dining hall.
m300416.みんなー！\n今日はアンナの年末ライヴに来てくれて、ありがとー！！:
Everyone!
Thank you so much for coming to Anna's year-end live show!!
m300416.むっ……それは魔界の門開通記念に、\n極少数だけ生産された\n魔神レラジェ様フィ: Hmph…… Is that not the Demon God Leraje figure that was produced in extremely limited quantities to commemorate the opening of the Demon Realm gates?
m300416.も、モーティマさんが\nつるつると床を滑り、右から左へ！？: M-Mortimer is sliding across the slippery floor, from right to left!?
m300416.やがて、ゴブリンとの戦闘が発生。\nパラベルの指揮のもと、バルバストラフは離れた:
Eventually, a battle with goblins broke out.
Under Parabel's command, Barbastroff stayed at a distance,
while the other four grouped together to repel the goblins.
m300416.やだっ！？ 当たると痛いんですよこれぇ……。\nしっしっ！ もうっ、次から次へと:
No way?! They hurt when they hit you…
Shh, shh! Ugh, one thing after another…
m300416.よく遊び、よく食べて、適度な運動をして。\n今年が、平和で健康な一年になるといい:
Play well, eat well, and exercise in moderation.
I hope this year will be a peaceful and healthy one for all of us.
m300416.りょーかい。\n出てくる奴ら、みんな倒せばいいってことね？:
Got it.
So we just need to defeat everyone who shows up, right?
m300416.わっせ、わっせ。はぁ～重たい。\nでも、あたしはつよつよだもんっ！\nこれくらい:
Whoa, whoa. Haa~ it's heavy.
But I'm super strong, you know!
I can carry this much…… Kyaaah!?
m300416.んんん、いえ、これは忘れ物ではなく……。\nほら、見てください。\nこの人形と一: No, no, it's not a lost item……. Look, please. There's a doll here, along with a letter.
m300416.アラン、覚えておくといいですわ。\nしんみりした雰囲気の時にこそ、\nトラブルは:
Aran, you'd better remember this.
Trouble has a way of swooping in
precisely when the atmosphere is most solemn.
m300416.ガンスリンガーのパラベルですの。\n戦いのときに、配置を指示したのはベルですの。:
I am the Gunslinger, Parabel.
I was the one directing the formations during the battle.
m300416.ガンスリンガー・パラベル。\nきみが、バルバストラフを殺した犯人だね？:
Gunslinger Parabel.
You're the one who killed Barbastroff, aren't you?
m300416.ギャギャ……ヤラレゾメ……。\nデモ、オナベノレシピ、アリガト……。:
Gyagya... a tough one...
But, thanks for the nabe recipe...
m300416.コマだけ狙えばいいってわけね！\n新年早々だけど、村を守るために戦うわよ！:
So we just need to target the tops!
It's the start of the New Year, but we'll fight to protect the village!
m300416.ゴブリンの来襲も、きみが仕組んだのだろう。\nそして戦闘の指揮を執るふりをして、:
The goblin raid was your doing, too.
Pretending to command the battle, you guided everyone except the victims
into the range of Elias's healing.
m300416.チェーンソッソッソォッ！！\nもちろん村は直してくぜぇーッ！\n後片付けまでがコ:
CHAIN-SON-SON-SON!!
Of course I'll fix the village, you guys!
Cleaning up is part of the top-spinning game, after all!
m300416.ノストラさんは、猫舌なのですね。\nふーふーして食べるといいと思います。:
It seems Nostra has a sensitivity to hot food.
I think it would be best to blow on it before eating.
m300416.ノストラちゃんはアヅミさんより前へ！\nベルは背後より援護しますの！\nエリアス:
Nostra, move ahead of Azumi!
I'll provide support from the rear!
Elias, please keep the three of us healed!
m300416.ハイエロファントには、毒からの回復を\n促進させる力がある。遅効性であり、潜伏期:
The Hierophant has the power to accelerate recovery from poison. Since it's a slow-acting toxin that's harmless during its incubation period,
he should have been able to neutralize it completely.
m300416.ハイエロファントのエリアスです。\nお鍋をぴかぴかに洗いました。:
I am the Hierophant, Elias.
I washed the pot until it was sparkling clean.
m300416.ハロウィンじゃなくてお正月だろ……！: It's not Halloween, it's the New Year...!
m300416.バルおじいちゃんは、\n離れた位置から補佐をお願いしますの！:
Old Man Barb,
please assist us from a safe distance!
m300416.バルおじいちゃんは、よく遊んでくれましたの。\nこの新年会も、二人で企画しました:
Old Man Bar always played with me.
The two of us planned this New Year's party.
He looked so happy today……
m300416.ベルは、大好きな人が苦しみながら\n死んでいくのを見たくない。\nだから――苦し:
Bell doesn't want to watch someone she loves die in agony.
So――I gave her that poison, so she could pass away without suffering.
m300416.マインさんが地雷をばら撒きながらこちらへ！？\n彼女の地雷の威力は凄まじいです。:
Mine is sliding toward us while scattering mines!
Her mines are incredibly powerful.
Please be careful not to step on any!
m300416.マーチャントのノストラよ。\n食材は私が切ったけど、それが何？:
It's the Merchant, Nostra.
I chopped the ingredients, but what of that?
m300416.ワシは新年を穏やかに祝い、\nまったりと過ごしたいのだがね……。:
I was hoping to celebrate the New Year peacefully
and spend it in a relaxed manner, but...
m300416.ワシも手伝おう。\n修理においてもグレーターデーモンを超えていることを、\n皆に:
I'll lend a hand, too.
Let's show everyone that I'm even better than Greater Demons at repairs.
m300416.ヴァンパイアの姫君よ、\n共にうさぎの暴走を鎮めましょう。:
Princess of the Vampires,
let us quell the rabbits' rampage together.
m300416.一時はどうなることかと思いましたが……。\n無事、完遂できましたね！:
For a moment, I thought things were going to go terribly wrong…
But we managed to finish everything safely!
m300416.不思議ですよね、東の国の初詣というものは。\n普段は静かで、厳かで、とても穏やか:
It's quite a mystery, isn't it, this New Year's tradition of the Eastern lands.
Usually, the shrine is so quiet, solemn, and peaceful, yet――
m300416.久しぶりの再会にとんだ挨拶だな、友よ。\n少しお前に聞いておきたいことがあってな:
A hell of a greeting for a reunion, friend.
I just have a few questions for you.
m300416.人呼んで、『懺悔室の雪』。\nほとんど苦痛なく死に至ることから、\n一部の国では:
They call it "Snow of the Confessional."
Because it leads to death with almost no pain,
it is used for euthanasia in some countries—and for executions.
m300416.今まですみませんでした。: I apologize for my behavior until now.
m300416.今日はなんと、\n魔界からもファンの皆が来てくれています。\n魔界のみんなー！:
Today, we even have fans coming from the Demon Realm.
Everyone from the Demon Realm! Thank you!
m300416.今日は神事の日でもありますから。\nきっと、言葉は通じずとも、\n神聖なこの気配:
Today is also a day of sacred rites.
Even if they don't understand the words,
they must have sensed the holy presence here.
m300416.何かありましたか？\n忘れ物なら受付に届けないと……。: Was something the matter? If it's a lost item, we need to turn it in at the reception…….
m300416.余では些か不足であろうが、\n今回のところは我慢してくれ。:
I may be a step below,
but please bear with me this once.
m300416.偽物だから別に痛くないんでしょ？\n斬られたぐらいでガタガタ言わない！:
It's a fake, so it doesn't hurt, does it?

Stop complaining just because you got cut!
m300416.優しいきみのことだ、断罪する勇気が出ないのだね。\n自らの意思で犯人を指し示すこ:
Being as gentle as you are, you must lack the courage to condemn.
Accusing someone of your own volition comes with a responsibility that can be crushing. I'll take it on.
m300416.出ますか……！\nグレーターデーモン時代に磨いていた、\n超絶爆転コマ回しが……:
You're going to do it...!
That super-explosive top-spinning technique you honed during your Greater Demon days...!
m300416.助手王子さん、証言は聞き終わりましたか？\nバルバストラフさんを殺した犯人は、誰:
Assistant Prince, have you finished hearing the testimonies?
Who is the one who killed Barbastroff?
--- scene: story talk 1 ---
m300416.周辺に棲息する野生の魔物も、\n根こそぎ引き寄せられたようです。\nしばらくは、: It appears the wild monsters living in the area were all drawn in as well. The nearby villages should be safe for a while.
m300416.問題ありませんよ。\nこれから掃除をするのですから。\n少々手間が省けたと思えば:
It's no problem.
We're about to start cleaning anyway.
Think of it as saving a bit of effort……, right?
m300416.問題なのは――この中に、\nバルバストラフを殺した犯人が居るということだ。:
The real problem is this—
the person who killed Barbastroph is among us.
m300416.困った男だ、本当に。\nこんな悪夢を見るくらいにあれこれと抱え込んで……。:
He really is a troublesome man.
Carrying all that weight on his shoulders, until he has a nightmare like this…
m300416.大掃除だから仕方ないでしょう。\n神殿に地雷を保管してると聞いた時は、\n驚いち:
It's a year-end cleaning, so it can't be helped.
I was surprised to hear they stored mines in the temple!
And there are this many of them!
m300416.大方、干支交代の神事に引き寄せられて、\n飛び込んできたのでしょう。:
They were likely drawn in by the ritual
marking the change of the zodiac sign.
m300416.奪うというなら、お帰り願おう。\nさあここはひとつ、わしが指揮を――:
If you mean to take it by force, then I shall escort you out.
Very well, let me take command and—
m300416.容疑者の中に、治癒能力のあるクラスの者がいるね。\nその力を利用すれば、解毒は間:
One of the suspects belongs to a class with healing abilities.
If that power had been used, the antidote would have arrived in time.
So then…… who arranged for everyone except the victim to be healed?
m300416.少々破れていますが、調理法はこの紙に。\nアヅミが誰かを手に掛けるとして、\n料:
The recipe is on this paper, though it's a bit worn.
Even if I did kill someone,
I would never use food as a weapon.
m300416.己の祈りや癇癪ひとつで、他者の命に手を掛ける我儘。\n美しいものと見紛いやすくは:
Taking another's life based on your own prayers or tantrums is selfish.
It may look beautiful, but
it's not a virtue to be praised.
m300416.年越しそば！ 毎年密かな楽しみなんですよね。: New Year's soba! It's a little secret joy of mine every year.
m300416.彼だけじゃありません！\n掃除をしていた兵士たちが、\n床の上をつるつる滑り始め:
It's not just him!
The soldiers who were cleaning are
starting to slide around on the floor!
m300416.彼の死因が分かった――飲食に混ぜての毒殺だよ。: I have determined the cause of death—poisoning via food or drink.
m300416.彼らの神はオリュンポス第５層、\nタカマガハラに籠もっているというのに、\nそれ:
Their god is said to be sequestered in Takamagahara,
the fifth layer of Olympus,
and yet they still use their faith as a guide for their daily lives.
m300416.念のためにもう一度言っておくが、\n場所を示すときには、\n姿が隠れていない者に:
Just to be safe, I'll say it again:
when you're pointing out a location,
please make sure you're aiming at someone who's actually visible!
m300416.怪しいと思う者の前に、調査員を配置してみたまえ。\n全員容疑者なのだから、全員へ:
Please place an investigator in front of whoever you suspect.
Since they are all suspects, I recommend questioning every single one of them.
m300416.恐らく親分ミミックだね。\n子分を倒されてお怒りの様子だ。\n強敵だよ。王子、頑:
It's probably the alpha mimic.
It seems angry about losing its minions.
It's a tough enemy. Let's do our best, Prince.
m300416.意外と才能が有ったりして♪\nふふ、モーティマおじさま。一緒にレッスンはいかが？:
He's surprisingly talented♪
Hehe, Uncle Mortimer. How about a lesson together?
m300416.愚問だね。\nさぁ、過酷なコマ回しをはじめるよ。:
A foolish question.
Now then, let us begin this grueling top-spinning match.
m300416.手紙にはなんと？: And what does the letter say?
m300416.改めてようこそ、今は亡き友人から譲り受けた別荘へ。\nそして今日呼んだのは、わし:
Welcome once again to the villa I inherited from my late friend.
And the ones I invited today are those who look after me.
I'm grateful you're spending the New Year with this old man.
m300416.料理人のアヅミでございます。\n食材の調達や調理は、大半をアヅミが行いました。:
I am the Cook, Azumi.
I handled most of the ingredient sourcing and preparation.
m300416.暴れているのは……アルミラージに、\nボーパルバニーでしょうか？:
The ones causing the commotion are... the Almiraj,
and perhaps some Bopal Bunnies?
m300416.最初に「アイドルやりたい」と言い出した時は、\nとうとう過労で、仕事をしながら\:
When you first said you wanted to be an idol,
I thought you were finally starting to dream
while working yourself to death from overwork……
m300416.本来はフェイロンの予定だったのだがな。\n天界との決戦に備えるための首脳会談とな:
Feiron was originally supposed to attend.
But when it comes to a summit to prepare for the decisive battle against the Celestial Realm,
he felt his rank wasn't high enough and begged off.
m300416.村に魔物が出没したと報告を受けて来ましたが、\nあれが噂のチェインソン男ですか…:
We received a report of monsters appearing in the village and came to investigate,
but is that the infamous Chainson Man...?
m300416.東の国のお祭りには、\n屋台や出し物がつきものだと聞いています。\nせっかく来た:
I've heard that festivals in the East
are always accompanied by stalls and entertainment.
Since we've come this far, let's enjoy the people's festival.
m300416.東の民の、大切な初詣。\n私たちで守ってあげませんと。:
The people of the East's precious New Year's visit.
We must protect it.
m300416.死に損ないの鼠風情に世界の運命は変えられぬ。\n神の雷霆に裁かれる日を、首を洗っ:
A half-dead rat like you cannot change the fate of the world.
Wash your neck and await the judgment of the divine thunderbolt.
m300416.気にしない気にしない。\nほら、悪ノリは、できるときに！:
Don't worry about it.
Come on, you've got to ride the wave when you can!
m300416.然るべき機関に、出頭しましょう。\n私があなたを救う方法は、もう、それしかないん:
Let us turn ourselves in to the proper authorities.
That is the only way I can save you now.
m300416.犯人が分かったら、\nアンナ警部にひとこと伝えるんだよ。:
Once you've figured out the culprit,
give Inspector Anna a heads-up.
m300416.生憎と余には生きて果たさねばならん使命がある。\n行くぞ聞忠、我らも役に立つこと:
Unfortunately, I have a mission I must fulfill while I live.

Come, Wen Zhong. It's time we proved our worth.
m300416.異端に教える義理などない。\nいいか、覚えておけよドゥマルデ。\n貴様とは決着を:
I have no obligation to explain myself to a heretic.
Listen well, Domalde.
The day of our reckoning will come.
m300416.異端の徒よ、これは宣戦布告です。\n我ら神聖騎士団は異端審問会を発動します。\n:
Heretic, consider this a declaration of war.

We, the Holy Knights, are convening the Inquisition.

The defendant is the entirety of the material and demon worlds. No exceptions.
m300416.皆さん大掃除お疲れ様です。\nケイティさん、進捗の程はどうですか？:
Everyone, thank you for your hard work on the cleaning.
Katie, how is the progress going?

I see you have brought excellent guards, everyone.
So I allowed myself to bring a force capable of holding its own.

Stop talking like the real culprit!

Wiping down the soap suds, removing the mines,
and fighting the mimics… all done.

I think I'll join in on that exercise routine too.

regardless of whether gods exist or not?

the poison was mixed into the pot, and all the suspects had eaten from it.

I'll examine him! Everyone,
please stack the cushions to make a bed!

I used dashi from my hometown to make a special broth.
Please enjoy it.

A capricious inquisitor is no laughing matter.

How could a proud knight of the Thunder God stoop so low?

"The Great Detective Anabella: The Murder at Sanbyakuso Villa."
Let the show begin~♪

Please calm down.

From what I can see, the Golden Demon's top is defensive,
while the Chainson Man's is offensive!
However, the spin will slow down over time, and they'll likely stop on their own!

It's time for the resolution.

It's time for the investigation, Assistant Prince-kun.
Listen to the testimonies of the four suspects and deduce the true culprit.

Whether he remembers it after waking up is another matter,
but that is one way to look at it.

I passed the recipe for the hot pot to one of the retreating Goblins.
I'm sure they'll be gathering around a pot with their comrades, too.

Who committed murder using a slow-acting poison?
『Detective Anabella: The Murder at Sanhakusou』
――The Decisive Resolution Chapter!
m300416.違う違う！ 止まらないんだってば！！\nだ、誰かぁああ！！ 止め、止めてくれぇ！:
No, no! I can't stop! I'm out of control!
S-someone, help!! Please, stop me!
m300416.闇ギルドに居たときでさえ、噂にしか聞かない物騒な毒。\n随分お詳しいのね、帝国の:
Even when I was in the Dark Guild,
I only heard rumors of such a dangerous poison.
You know a great deal about it, don't you, you earnest Imperial?
m300416.雷神の遺志は未だ死んでいない、とな。: Tell them the will of the Thunder God is not yet dead.

Ah! Chloe! Where do you think you're going?

So you are a high-ranking Healer.
If Elias had been able to lend his power to her,
perhaps the poison could have been cured.
m300416.魔術師ギルドで周囲の警戒してますが、\n予想通りあちこちから魔物が接近中です。\: The Mage Guild has increased security in the surrounding area, but just as expected, monsters are approaching from all directions. Anna's singing, which attracts monsters, is quite something.
m300416.（……何が正しいのか、\n私も常に考え続けないと、いけませんね）:
(……I must always keep reflecting
on what is truly right)

(Is the goal to sabotage this summit?
If anything were to happen to the heads of state present here,
it would become an indelible stain on the kingdom's honor.)
m300416.（あの日、舞台の公演が終わったあと、\nパラベルとエリアスは、二人そろって楽屋で:
(That day, after the stage performance ended,
Parabel and Elias both went to the dressing room and cried their eyes out.
They must have gotten too caught up in the emotion of their acting.)
m300416.（おそろしく完成度の高い、死んだふりだ。\n本当に美しい、こちらが呼吸を忘れてし:

He's so beautiful, in fact, that I almost forgot to breathe……)
m300416.（この状況で責任を感じるなんて、優しい子だ。\n一人だけ洗い物係なのは気になるが:
(Feeling responsible in a situation like this…… she's such a kind soul.
It is a bit odd, though, that she was the only one assigned to wash the dishes……)
m300416.（この繁栄は、\n人々に進むべき道を委ねたからなのでしょうか）:
(Is this prosperity because they
left the path to the people themselves?)
m300416.（これこれ、わしは死体役じゃ。\n話しかけたら駄目じゃろう？ 推理、頑張るのじゃ:

You mustn't talk to me, now. Do your best with the deduction, won't you?)
m300416.（こんな、善性のひとだから。\nだからベルはこんなにも、あなたのことが――）:
(Because she is so good-hearted.
That is why Bell loves you so much—)
m300416.（だからって、あれを会談に混ぜる？\nやだやだ、いやらしいこと考えるね……）:
(But would you really involve that in a summit?
No way, no way... What a nasty thought...)
m300416.（まずマスクを取らせるべきだと思いますの。\nでも、そういうズレたとこもかわいい:
(I think we should have her take off her mask first.
But that kind of awkwardness is cute, too...)
m300416.（ハルモニア……昔の知り合いと会えて、\nテンションが上がってるのかな……）:
(Harmonia... She seems to be in a good mood,
now that she's reunited with an old acquaintance...)
m300416.（バルバストラフは、皆を見てにこにこしてた。\n髭で作られた沢山のちょうちょ結び:

He kept the many bows he had made with his beard
untied for the entire day.)

I once cried when a girl with a sparkling aura
picked up the pen I had dropped.)
m300416.（古ぼけているが、普通のレシピだ。\n言っていることは少し怖いが……）:
(It's old, but it's just a normal recipe.
What she's saying is a little unsettling, though……)
m300416.（台本にない台詞――アドリブだわ。\n生真面目なだけじゃないのね、あのお嬢さん）:
(Lines not in the script—improvisation.
She's not just a stickler for the rules, after all.)
m300416.（本当に仲が良かったのだと、伝わってくる。\n被害者を単身で遊撃にあてたのは、信:
(You can tell they were truly close.
Did he send the victim out on a solo raid out of trust……?)
m300416.（東の国の神々は、人々を見守り、\n介入しないことを決めて、岩戸に籠もった）:
(The gods of the East decided to watch over the people
without interfering, and retreated into the Rock Cave)
m300416.（泣き疲れたパラベルとエリアスは、それから\n鍋をもりもり食べて、少しだけ正月太:
(After crying themselves out, Parabel and Elias
ate their fill of hot pot and apparently gained a little holiday weight.)
m300416.（闇ギルド出身というが、被害者には懐いていたようだ。\n食材を刃物で切るだけで、:
(She's from the Dark Guild, but she clearly liked the victim.
Can you really kill a specific person just by cutting ingredients?)

m400243.まさかとは思うが、\n魔王軍が暗躍している可能性もあるだろ？\n注意しておくに越: It sounds far-fetched, but there's a chance the Demon King's army is pulling the strings. We'd be wise to stay on guard.
m400243.よぉ王子。遅かったじゃないか。\nほら、軍議の時間だぜ？: Hey, Prince. You're late. Come on, it's time for the council meeting.

m400243.沈まない岩場もあるはずだが、\n兵の配置には気をつけることだ。: There should be some rocky outcrops that stay above water, so be careful where you position your troops.

m400390.――王子、東の砦より伝令！\n正体不明の魔物の軍勢、さらに増加！: —Prince, a messenger from the eastern fortress! Unidentified monster forces are swelling!
m400390.……それもそうですね。\nあっ……でも、ここだけ微かに読み取れそうです。: …That's true. Ah… but I think I can pick up a faint clue here.

m400390.あぁ、アルレットさん。\nいえ、どうにも気になることがありまして。: Ah, Arlette. No, there's just something bothering me.
m400390.あぁっ、それはさっき買った焼きたてのー！？: Ah, that's the fresh-baked one I just bought!?

m400390.あんなものが今までに存在していたのなら、\n必ずどこかに記録が残っているはずだか: If something like that ever existed, there has to be some record of it somewhere.
m400390.いいえ、それがまったく……。\n魔物、事件、伝説、ありとあらゆる資料をあたっても: No, nothing at all... We've scoured every record on monsters, incidents, legends—nothing shows up, which is oddly suspicious.
m400390.これだけの数の魔物――いや、\n魔物かどうかすら分からないわけだが、\nそいつら: That many monsters—actually, we don't even know if they're monsters—where have they been all this time?
m400390.その可能性もありますが……。\nでも、何かが引っかかっているんです。: That's a possibility, but something just feels off.

m400390.ふふん、あんまり気にしてると、\n美味しいお菓子が美味しくなくなっちゃうぞっと♪: Hehe, if you worry about it too much, your tasty snacks will lose their flavor♪
m400390.ぶっちゃけ何も分からない！\nあえて記録を残さなかったんじゃないかって、\n疑い: Honestly, we have zero clues! It makes you wonder if they deliberately left no records, because there's just no information.
m400390.むぅ、自分の癖くらい分かりますよ。\nこの消し方は間違いなく、自分自身のものです: Mmm, I know my own habits. This way of erasing is definitely my own.

m400390.アイギス神殿防衛部隊からの連絡途絶！\n魔術師ギルドによる通信魔法にも応答ありま: Communications are down from the Aegis Temple defense unit! Even the mage guild's transmission magic gets no response!

m400390.悪いことが起きてたなら、\nこんな風におしゃべり出来ていないだろうし。: If something terrible had occurred, we wouldn't be chatting like this.
m400390.敵はいったい何者なんだ……。\n見たこともない魔物の群れに、\nそれを生み出す能: Who the hell are these enemies... A horde of monsters we've never seen, and the ability that creates them—information is all over the place!
m400390.確かにつけていたはずの日記が、\nほんの数行、なぜか抜け落ちているんです。: The diary I was keeping is missing a few lines, for some reason.

m400390.超巨大生物の頭部と思われるものが\n山脈を割って出現しました……！！: Something that looks like the head of a colossal creature has torn through the mountains and emerged…!!
m400390.青白い肌と、生物の常識を無視した肉体、\nそして自身を複製するあの特性……。: Pale blue skin, a body that defies all biological logic, and that ability to replicate itself...
m400390.（……忘れているだけでなく、\n自ら消した痕跡があるということは、\nきっと誰か: (Not only have I forgotten, but there's evidence I erased it myself—someone must've done a massive memory tampering…)
m400390.（でも、悪い気はしないですね。\nアルレットさんの言うとおり、\nきっと何か、良: (But it doesn't feel bad. Like Arlette said, maybe it was a good encounter.)

m500452.えぇ、あのような下賎の魔神が、\n我々の真似事をしようとは。\n不愉快極まりない:
Yes. For a wretched Demon God to imitate us……
It is most distasteful.
m500452.えぇ、中心地点であったビフロンスが消滅したなら、\nここも徐々に、通常の地下空間:
Yes. Now that Bifrons, the epicenter, is gone,
this place should gradually return to a normal underground space.
m500452.えぇと、まだ報告が終わってないのですが……。: Um, I haven't finished my report yet, but...
m500452.えっ、ぱ、パーティ？\n何のパーティを？:
Huh? A, a party?
What kind of party?
m500452.えっ、抜け駆けですかー！？\n王子、私とも踊ってください！:
Huh? You're trying to cut in line?!
Prince, dance with me too!
m500452.かつて砂漠を混乱に陥れたフェネクス！\n死者の眠りを阻むビフロンス！\nその魔神:
Fenech, who once plunged the desert into chaos!
Bifrons, who disturbed the sleep of the dead!
Those Demon Gods were defeated at the same time!
m500452.このまま放置すれば、\nいずれ物質界全体がビフロンスの魔力に覆われて――:
If we leave this unchecked,
eventually the entire Material World will be consumed by Bifrons's power――
m500452.この力、私たち\nヴァンパイアの血族に近いものですね。:
This power is close to that of
us vampires, the Bloodline.
m500452.これでまた一歩、\n平和な時代に近付いたということね。:
This brings us one step closer
to an era of peace.
m500452.これは……まさか魔界の瘴気か？: This is…… could it be the miasma of the Demon World?
m500452.その意気よ、砂漠の女王さま。: That's the spirit, Queen of the Desert.
m500452.それじゃあ、魔神退治と行きましょうか。\nダーリン、あなたの力、みせてちょうだい:
Well then, let's go hunt some demons.
Darling, show me what you're made of!
m500452.それでは、拠点へ戻りましょうか。\n王子、此度の魔神討伐、お疲れ様でした！:
Then, let's head back to base.
Prince, well done on subduing the Demon Gods!
m500452.そんなことは、絶対にさせません。\nここでビフロンス、フェネクスを叩きます！:
I will never allow that to happen.
We will strike down Bifrons and Phoenix right here!
m500452.っはぁ、はぁ……。\nくっ……生命力の吸収が、止まった？:
Haa…… haa……
Guh…… the life-force absorption has stopped?
m500452.な、何ですかあれ？\n小さな鳥みたいなものが召喚されました！:
W-What is that?
A small bird-like creature has been summoned!
m500452.なに、この死霊術は……。\nいいえ、違う、これは……。:
What is this necromancy…….
No, wait, this is…….
m500452.なるほど、危険ではあれど、\n魔神の問題を解決できる絶好の機会、と……。:
I see. Dangerous as it may be,
it's a prime chance to resolve the Demon God problem, then……
m500452.ふぅ……良かった……。\nこれで、砂漠地下の魔界化も止まるでしょうか。:
Phew…… Thank goodness…….
I hope this stops the Demon World from spreading under the desert.
m500452.ふふっ……はい、分かりました。\n必ずや、この御恩はお返ししますね。:
Fufu…… Very well, understood.
I will certainly repay this debt of gratitude.
m500452.ふふっ、夜の王の機嫌を損ねるなんて、\nビフロンスも運の尽きかしら。:
Fufu. To ruin the Night King's mood……
Bifrons truly has run out of luck.
m500452.ほら、ビフロンス教団と\nフェネクス教団を同時に叩けるし……。: I mean, we can take down the Bifrons Cult and the Phoenix Cult all at once……
m500452.もうパーティ始まっちゃいますよ？\nほらほら、中庭に急いで急いで！:
The party is about to start!
Come on, come on, hurry to the courtyard!
m500452.もうビフロンスにも、フェネクスにも、\nこの世界に顕現するだけの力は残っていませ:
Neither Bifrons nor Fenech
has enough power left to manifest in this world.
m500452.んん～……ふぁ……あふ……。\nえっとー、途中からしか聞いてなかったけど、\nも:
Mmm…… fff…… ah……
I only caught part of it, but maybe this is actually a good opportunity.
m500452.ダーリン、今なら\n魔神を消滅させられるわ！ とどめを！！:
Darling, now's our chance
to obliterate the demons! Finish them off!!
m500452.ビフロンスがフェネクスを制御下に置いたなら、\nその内側には、魔神２体分の魔力が:
If Bifrons has Phoenix under its control,
that means the power of two Demon Gods is swirling inside it.
If we strike now, we might be able to destroy it completely.
m500452.ビフロンスによって、\n魔力が暴走させられているみたいね。:
It looks like Bifrons is
causing its magic power to run wild.
m500452.ビフロンスは不死、フェネクスは再生を司る魔神。\nいずれも近い権能を持つ存在だか:
Bifrons governs undeath, while Phoenix governs regeneration.
Because their powers are so closely related, the two cults have always been at odds with each other……
m500452.ビフロンスばかりが敵じゃない。\nフェネクスの出現にも備えておけよ。:
It's not just Bifrons we have to worry about.
Be ready for Phoenix's appearance, too.
m500452.ビフロンス教団がフェネクス教団を取り込み、\n魔神顕現の儀式を始めやがった。: The Bifrons Cult has absorbed the Phoenix Cult and begun the ritual to manifest the Demon Gods.
m500452.ビフロンス教団は、魔神の力を借りて\nフェネクス教団員の精神を支配したようだ。: It appears the Bifrons Cult used the Demon God's power to dominate the minds of the Phoenix Cult's members.
m500452.フェネクスか……。\nまたこいつと戦うことになるなんてな。:
Phoenix……
To think I'd have to fight this guy again.
m500452.フェネクスが……生命力を吸い取っているの！？: Fenech is…… draining the life force?!
m500452.フェネクスの残穢、とでも呼ぶべきかしら。\n拠点に向かってくる様子はなさそうね。:
We might as well call it Fenech's residual impurity.
It doesn't seem to be heading toward our base.
Does it lack a will of its own?
m500452.フェネクスは周囲の敵を回復させる力を持っているわ。\n戦いが長引けば、それだけこ:
Phoenix has the power to heal nearby enemies.
The longer this battle drags on, the more the odds stack up against us!
m500452.厚意は遠慮なく受け取っておけばいい。\n次に王国の窮地を救えば、\nそれが恩返し:
We should accept your kindness without hesitation.
If we save the Kingdom from its next predicament,
that will serve as the repayment.
m500452.実質的に、ビフロンスがフェネクスを\n手中に収めたに等しい状況だと言える。: In effect, Bifrons has placed Phoenix entirely under its control.
m500452.意思の有無は関係ありません！\n放置すれば敵の傷が癒えていきます。\n王子、手早:
Whether it has a will or not is irrelevant!
If we leave it alone, it will heal the enemy's wounds.
Prince, let's put it down quickly!
m500452.攻撃を受けたら、\nその分ビフロンスの傷が癒えていくということね？:
So when it takes damage,
Bifrons's wounds heal in proportion to it?
m500452.既に魔神ビフロンスは顕現しています。\n砂漠の民で、どうにか儀式を妨害しています:
Demon God Bifrons has already manifested.
The people of the desert are doing their best to disrupt the ritual,
but Phoenix's emergence is only a matter of time.
m500452.気持ち悪いくらいの生命力を感じるわ。\nおそらく、フェネクスの回復の権能が\n具:
I can feel an overwhelming amount of life force.
It's likely the manifestation of Fenech's authority of restoration.
m500452.決まってるじゃないですか！\nビフロンス、フェネクス討伐凱旋パーティですよ！:
It's obvious, isn't it!
It's a victory party for the subjugation of Bifrons and Fenech!
m500452.無理もないわ。\nあれだけ強力な魔神を、\n二体も同時に倒したのだもの。:
That's only natural.
You defeated two such powerful Demon Gods simultaneously.
m500452.王子、みなさん、\n砂漠の国を危機から\n救っていただき、ありがとうございました:
Prince, everyone,
thank you for saving the desert nation
from this crisis.
m500452.癒やしではなく、生命力を奪うとは……。\n再生の権能とは、\nまるっきり正反対の:
Not healing, but stealing life……
It seems the power of regeneration has awakened as
the exact opposite force.
m500452.砂漠の国は、\nいつも王国と共に戦ってくれていますから。:
The desert nation
has always fought alongside the Kingdom.
m500452.砂漠の民、みんな大喜びだよ？\n王子さまもはやく。一緒に踊ろ？:
The people of the desert are overjoyed!
Prince, come quickly. Let's dance together!
m500452.良いではないか。\n兵の慰労もまた、王子の役割だろう？:
It is a fine opportunity.
Comforting your soldiers is also a duty of the Prince, is it not?
m500452.見た目以上の力を持っているだろうから、\n油断しないように気をつけてね。:
It's likely far stronger than it looks,
so be careful not to let your guard down.
m500452.間に合って、よかった……。: I'm glad we made it in time…….
m500452.魔力自体は残留していますが、\nその消滅も時間の問題でしょう。:
The magic power itself remains,
but its dissipation is only a matter of time.
m500452.魔神が出現した以上、王国は助力を惜しみません。\n王子、すぐに魔神討伐の準備をお:
Now that the Demon Gods have appeared, the Kingdom will spare no aid.
Prince, please prepare for the Demon God's subjugation immediately!
m500452.魔神ビフロンス、魔神フェネクス、\n魔力が暴走しています！:
Demon God Bifrons, Demon God Phoenix,
their magic power is running wild!

m500465.――この世界に生まれてくることは、\n決して、悲劇ばかりではないと、伝わっていれ:
――I hope it gets across that being born into this world
is not always a tragedy.
m500465.――ただ、後悔だけがありました。: ――There was only one thing I regretted.
m500465.――もう一度だけ、あなたに会いたかったのです。: ――I just wanted to see you one more time.
m500465.――やはり、こうなるのか。: ――So it has come to this, after all.
m500465.――哀れみなど不要だと、\n生命は生を謳歌する力を持っていると、\nペルセフォネ:
I shall teach Persephone that pity is unnecessary,
that life possesses the power to celebrate its own existence…
and then, I shall bury her.
m500465.――愛を……。\n永遠に続く生と死の連環に、終わりの時を。:
—Love….
An end to the eternal cycle of life and death.
m500465.――結局、ハイドースの儀式って\nいったいなんだったでありますか？: ――So, what on earth was that ritual of Hyades?
m500465.……あなたって、時々感傷的になるわよね。: ……You can be quite sentimental sometimes, can't you?
m500465.……これは、彼女の残留思念のようね。\nあまりにも強すぎる執着が、\nペルセフォ:
……This seems to be her residual thought.
Her obsession is so powerful that it is keeping Persephone tethered to this world.
m500465.……なんか、思った以上に詩人でありますな。: ……You're more of a poet than I expected.
m500465.……まずいわね。\n「冥界の霊花」が枯れ始めた……。:
……This is bad.
The “Spirits of the Underworld” are beginning to wither…
m500465.……やられたわ。\nここはペルセフォネの紡いだ幻の中よ。:
……We've been had.
This is an illusion woven by Persephone.
m500465.……ルスティ、ジュディス、\n急ぎ全軍の健康状態を確認。\n夢から覚めているか確:
……Rusti, Judithe,
check the health of the entire army immediately.
Confirm that everyone is awake from the dream.
m500465.……何か、様子がおかしいな。\nまさか、周囲の敵を強化する魔力を帯びているのか？:
……Something feels off.
Could it be that they are imbued with the power to strengthen nearby enemies?
m500465.……分からんこともない。\nひどく人間くさい考え方にも思えるが、\n神もまたひと:
……It's not beyond my understanding.
It may seem terribly human,
but if one considers a god to be a form of life, it makes sense.
m500465.……好き勝手言ってくれるわね。: ……How bold of you to speak so freely.
m500465.……己を殺した俺たちに、復讐でもするつもりか？: ……Are you trying to take revenge on us for killing you?
m500465.……我を呼んだのは、\nやはり、君だったか、ペルセフォネ。:
……It was you, after all,
who called me, Persephone.
m500465.……無理よ。\n神はそのあり方を変えられない。\n彼女は、死をもって世界を救う気:
…No, we can't.
A god cannot change their nature.
She intends to save the world through death.
m500465.ああ、ああ……。\n我に、生きる目的を与えようというのか。\n君のいない世界で、:
Ah, ah…
You wish to give me a reason to keep living.
A meaning to my struggle in a world without you…
m500465.ああ、ああ……！\n白の帝国に鉄槌を、アダマスに滅びを、\nすべての生命に死の安:
Ah, ah…!
I shall bring the hammer of iron upon the White Empire,
destruction upon Adamas,
and the peace of death to all living things…!!
m500465.ああ、創造神よ、あなたの紡いだこの世界に、\n永遠なる安らぎの死をもたらしましょ:
Ah, Creator. In this world you have woven,
I shall bring the eternal peace of death.
m500465.ああ。総員、剣をとれ。\n――ペルセフォネに、俺たちが決して、\n弱くもなく、哀:
Indeed. All units, draw your swords.
—Let us show Persephone that we are neither weak nor pitiful.
m500465.あなたが、世界を、滅ぼすの。\nそうすることで、生まれてくる苦しみから、\nすべ:
You will destroy the world.
By doing so, you will save all life
from the suffering that would otherwise be born.
m500465.あの時、あの人と戦った者たち。\nそれだけの縁があれば、\nこの幻に、あの人を喚:
Those who fought that person back then.
That bond alone is enough
to summon that person into this illusion…
m500465.あれが枯れるということは、\n彼女の与えた権能もまた反転する。\n周囲の敵対者―:
If they wither, the authority she bestowed will reverse.
The enemies around us—meaning us—will have our power drained.
m500465.あれは「冥界の霊花」……。\nペルセフォネがもたらした、冥界に咲く花よ。:
Those are “Spirits of the Underworld”….
Flowers that bloom in the realm of the dead, brought forth by Persephone.
m500465.いいえ、「冥界の霊花」は、\n生命の象徴たる植物と、\n冥界を同時に司るペルセフ: No. The “Spirits of the Underworld” are Persephone's flowers, governing both plants, the symbol of life, and the Underworld itself.
m500465.いいえ、いいえ。\nあなたに、こんなにも愛されているのだもの。:
No, no.
You love me so deeply.
m500465.いつまで落ち込んだ顔をしている。\nこういう時、兵に必要なのはなんだ？:
How long are you going to wear that downcast face?
What do soldiers need in times like this?
m500465.えぇー。\n亜神だって恋のひとつやふたつ――ってレオナ様ァ！？:
Wha—?
Even a demigod can have a crush or two—Leona?!
m500465.えっ、そう？ そうです？\nえへへぇ、退役したら宮廷詩人にでも――:
Huh? Really?
Really?
Hehehe, once I retire, I could be a court poet—
m500465.えっ、それはもうアレですよ。\nほら、愛する貴女にもう一度会いたい～って。: Eh, well, it was just that sort of thing. You know, “I want to see the one I love again~” and all that.
m500465.おい、職務の最中に――うっ……何だ、これは……。: Hey, in the middle of a duty—ugh… What is this…?
m500465.おぉ、おぉ……ペルセフォネ……。\nやはり運命は覆らなかった……。:
Oh… oh… Persephone…
It seems fate could not be turned aside…
m500465.けれど、それは叶わぬ望み、遂げられぬ願い。\n己を律する法に縛られる私たちでは、:
But that is an unfulfillable hope, an unattainable wish.
Bound by the laws that govern us,
we can never even touch such feelings…
m500465.これだけの規模の魔力……。\n王国からの報告にあった「大神」と同等の存在かと。:
Magical power on this scale…
It must be an entity equivalent to the “Great God” mentioned in the Kingdom's reports.
m500465.さぁ、終わらせてあげましょう。\n私たちを愛してくれた、神たる彼女を。:
Come, let us put her to rest.
The goddess who loved us.
m500465.さぁ、観客が待っているわ。\nこれが私の、最後の舞台。\nどうか、最後まで、あな:
Now then, the audience is waiting.
This is my final stage.
Please, stay by my side until the very end.
m500465.ずっと、あのうわ言を繰り返している……？: Has she been repeating that same phrase this whole time…?
m500465.それが罠だったのかも。\nともかく、全員離れないで。\n何が起きるかわからないか:
Perhaps that was the trap.
In any case, don't separate.
We don't know what might happen.
m500465.だが、俺が戦った意味は、きっとあったはずだ。: But I believe my fight must have meant something.
m500465.だって、もし大好きな人と離れ離れになって、\nその人はすぐ近くにいるのに、顔も見:
Well, if you were separated from someone you loved dearly,
and they were right there, but you couldn't even see their face…
m500465.っ……だめ、これは……この呼び声は……。\nみんな、意識をはっきり……持っ……て:
N-No, this is… this call is…
Everyone, keep your… minds… clear!
If we stay like this—
m500465.でも、やっぱりあれは……愛情だと思うんですよねー。: But, I really do think it was… a matter of the heart.
m500465.どうやら、先の戦いでは失われていた\nペルセフォネ本来の権能を取り戻したようね。: It appears she has regained her original divine authority, which was lost in our previous encounter.
m500465.なんてこと……。\nペルセフォネが、完全に正気を取り戻している……。:
What is this…
Persephone has fully regained her sanity…
m500465.ふぁ……あふぅ……。\n夜ふかしのツケが……？:
Wha… ah…
The price of staying up late…?
m500465.まさか己の魂を維持することよりも、\n願いを優先してくるなんて。:
I never imagined she would prioritize her wish
over maintaining her own soul.
m500465.むっ……？\n枯れてしまうなら、むしろ有利なのでは？:
Hmph…?
If they're withering, isn't that actually in our favor?
m500465.ようこそ、私の庭園へ。\nアダマスの子らよ、\nあなたたちには、触媒となってもら:
Welcome to my garden.
Children of Adamas,
I am going to use you as a catalyst.
m500465.りょーかい！\nジュディスちゃん急げ急げ！:
Roger that!
Come on, Judithe-chan, hurry up!
m500465.わっ……何かお花が――\nめっちゃ禍々しいでありますな！？:
Wha… what are those flowers—
They're incredibly ominous, aren't they!?
m500465.ペルセフォネ……！\nやはり生きていたのね。:
Persephone…!
So you were still alive.
m500465.ペルセフォネ、今からでも遅くない。\n世界など捨て、ふたりで――:
Persephone, it is not too late.
Let us abandon this world, and the two of us—
m500465.メーア、お前の小隊の報告書がまだだぞ。\nサボるなとは言わないが、\nもう少し見:
Meer, your squad's report is still outstanding.
I'm not saying don't slack off, but
try to do it somewhere out of sight.
m500465.ユッタ！ 祝宴の準備をしろ！\n大神ペルセフォネ、討伐完了の宴だ！:
Yutta! Prepare a feast!
A celebration for the defeat of the Great Goddess Persephone!
m500465.世界のことなど、創造神の子らのことなど、\n何もかも忘れて、あなたと生きていけた:
That I could have forgotten about the world, forgotten about the children of the Creator,
forgotten everything, and lived with you.
m500465.二度と、二度と会えぬと……思っていた。\nあの儀式を遂げられなかった以上、\n君:
I thought I would never see you again…
Since I failed to complete that ritual,
I believed your soul had already dissipated…
m500465.他の医官にも指示を出してきます！\n手分けして確認しましょう！:
I'll give orders to the other medics too!
Let's split up and check on everyone!
m500465.何とかな……。: We managed to make it through…
m500465.俺もまた、人間だというだけの話だ。: It just means I am human, too.
m500465.個体としての魔力を感じない――いや、\nこの領域全体がペルセフォネの魔力に満ちて:
I don't sense any individual magical power—no,
is this entire domain saturated with Persephone's power?
m500465.先程までとは真逆の性質になるということか……！: So its nature has become the exact opposite of what it was just moments ago…!
m500465.全員、戦闘に備えて！\n今の彼女なら、神の楔に匹敵する奇跡を――:
Everyone, prepare for combat!
In her current state, she is capable of miracles
rivaling the Divine Wedge…
m500465.全員目を覚まして！\n急ぎ戦闘準備を！ ここは、ペルセフォネの幻の中よ！:
Everyone, wake up!
Get ready for battle! We're inside Persephone's illusion!
m500465.君を喪う悲しみを……。\n此度はアダマスの信徒どもが……！:
The sorrow of losing you…
This time, it is the followers of Adamas…!
m500465.哀れなる人の子らに、離別の苦しみなき世界を。: To the wretched children of man, a world free from the pain of parting.
m500465.彼女の――ペルセフォネの夢に引き込まれる！！: We'll be pulled into her dream—Persephone's dream!!
m500465.愛だろうと何だろうと、関係ない。\n愛があれば世界を滅ぼしていいなどという道理も:
Whether it is love or whatever else, it is irrelevant.
There is no logic to the idea that love justifies the destruction of the world.
m500465.我も……同じ気持ちだった……。\n長き時の中でひび割れ、荒廃していく庭園を見て、:
I… felt the same way…
Watching the garden crack and wither over the long ages,
I was afraid that my own love would vanish from within me…
m500465.敵は、愛ゆえに\n物質界を滅ぼさんとした大神ペルセフォネ。\n白の帝国が相対する:
The enemy is Persephone, the Great God who sought to destroy the material world out of love.
She is a worthy opponent for the White Empire, wouldn't you say?
m500465.敵兵を強化する魔力とは、厄介だな……。\n優先して刈り取れ！ 戦場に残しておくと:
The power to enhance enemy troops is troublesome….
Prioritize cutting them down! Leaving them on the battlefield is dangerous!
m500465.極めて巧妙に編み上げられた、\n現実と地続きの幻ね。:
It was an illusion, skillfully woven
so that it was continuous with reality.
m500465.正気なら！ 話し合いとか！ できたりしない！？: If she's sane! Can't we just… talk this out!?
m500465.歪んでいても、愛は愛ですわよ？: Even if it is twisted, love is still love, isn't it?
m500465.相手は亜神だぞ。\nそんな私的な感情で動くものか。\n本心はまた別のところにあっ:
The other party is a demigod.
They don't act on such personal feelings.
Their true intentions must have lain elsewhere.
m500465.私はすぐに消えてしまうけれど、\nそれでも、もう一度あなたに抱きしめてほしかった:
I will fade away soon,
but I still wanted to be held by you one more time.
m500465.答えが分かっているのに確認するのは、\nあなたの悪い癖よ？:
You know the answer already, yet you still ask.
That is quite the bad habit of yours, isn't it?
m500465.総員抜剣！\n大神ペルセフォネをここで討つ！！:
All units, draw your swords!
We shall slay the Great Goddess Persephone here and now!!
m500465.許さぬぞ、白の皇帝！\nアダマスと共に、貴様の首を我が妻に捧げてくれる！:
I will not forgive you, White Emperor!
Together with Adamas, offer your head to my wife!
m500465.誕生には、離別と死が定められている。\n創造神よ、私はあなたを恨みます。\nなぜ:
Birth is destined to bring separation and death.
Creator, I hate you.
Why do you inflict such suffering on the children of man?
m500465.馬鹿な……。\nペルセフォネの魔力は完全に霧散していたはずだぞ。:
Ridiculous…
Persephone's magical power should have completely dissipated.
m500465.（本当に極めて困ったものですけど、\nさっきの話といい、やっぱり\nペルセフォネ: (It's a real headache, but judging from what we just heard, what's truly binding Persephone isn't obsession… it's something else.)

m500490.――いました。魔神グシオンです！: ――There he is. The Demon God Gushion.
m500490.――はーなーせー！\nオレは行かなきゃならないんだー！！:
――Haaanasee!
I've got to go do something about this!!
m500490.――王子！ 緊急の報告です！\nオークの村が魔神の襲撃を受けたとのこと！:
――Prince! An urgent report!
The Orc village has been attacked by a Demon God!
m500490.――魔神アガレス、魔神グシオンは、\n完全に消滅したと考えて良さそうです。:
――It seems we can assume that
Demon God Agares and Demon God Gushion
have been completely annihilated.
m500490.――魔神グシオン、魔神アガレス、\n両者の魔力が消滅していきます。:
――The magic power of Demon God Gushion and Demon God Agares
is dissipating.
m500490.――魔神グシオン。\nかつて王子が正々堂々打ち負かしたアイツが、\n再び姿を現し:
――it's the Demon God Gushion.
That same brute the Prince defeated in a fair fight has shown up again.
m500490.……どうやら、しばらく帰れなさそうだねぇ？: ……Looks like I won't be going home for a while, huh?
m500490.ああ。既に魔界闘技場だけでなく、\n近隣の村にも被害が出始めているらしい。:
Yes. It seems the damage isn't limited to the arena.
Reports indicate nearby villages are suffering casualties as well.
m500490.あっ、いえ、その前にしないといけないことが……。: Ah, no, before that, there's something we need to do...
m500490.あっ、困った顔してますねぇ。\nもっと笑顔で！ そうそう！ 英雄はそうじゃないと:
Oh, you've got a troubled look on your face.
Put on a smile! That's it! That's how a hero should be!
m500490.あのグシオンに限って、\nそんな情けないマネをするとは思えないが……。\nともあ:
I can't believe Gushion would stoop to such pathetic behavior...
But since there's actual damage, we have no choice but to deal with it.
m500490.あの周辺にはオークの集落もあったはずですし、\n急いで対応しないと、被害が拡大し:
There should be an Orc settlement nearby, too.
If we don't act quickly, the damage could spread.
m500490.あんたもかい？\nこれは、本当にグシオンの仕業なのか、\nどうにも信じられない。:
You too, huh?
I just can't believe this is really Gushion's doing.
m500490.い、いったい何があったのですか……？: W-what on earth is going on...?
m500490.いや、いくつか目撃情報がある。\n証言によれば――:
No. We have several eyewitness accounts.
According to the witnesses――
m500490.うおおおおおおおッ！！\n王国！ 王国！ 我らが英雄ッ！！:
YOOOOOOO!!
The Kingdom! The Kingdom!
Our heroes!!
m500490.うるさーい！\nあぁもう！ 誰かー！\n誰かドゥーラを止めてー！！:
Shut up!
Ugh, come on! Somebody!
Someone stop Doula!!
m500490.えぇ、王子の方を見て……なんというのか……。: Yes, he was looking at you, Prince... How to put it...
m500490.きゃー！？\n大きい岩を飛ばしてきましたよ！？:
Kyaa!?
He just threw a huge boulder at us!?
m500490.ここで仕留めるしかない。\nやつがこの包囲を抜け出したら、\nどんな被害が出るか:
We have to finish him here.
If he breaks through this encirclement,
we have no idea what kind of damage he'll cause.
m500490.さぁて、壊された集落の再建を手伝ってやらないとねぇ。\n魔界闘技場も作り直さない:
Now then, we'll have to help rebuild the destroyed settlements.
And we'll need to reconstruct the Demon Arena too.
m500490.さぁみんな、一度戦った相手ではあるけど、\n油断なんかするんじゃないよ。:
Now then, everyone. We've fought them before,
but don't let your guard down.
m500490.さぁグシオン、覚悟を決めなッ！！: Come on, Gushion! Face your fate!!
m500490.さて、それじゃああたしは、\n魔界の各地の様子を見てくるよ。:
Well then, I'm going to go check on the situation
across the Demon World.
m500490.しかし、ドゥーラの怒りもよく分かる。\n今、魔界で起きていることを考えればね。:
Still, I can understand why Doula is so angry.
Given what's happening in the Demon World right now.
m500490.ただ……これは、戦士の勘ってやつだけど……。: But... this is just a warrior's instinct, but...
m500490.ちぃっ、そういうことか！: Tch, so that's what's going on!
m500490.できれば、見間違いであってほしかったねぇ。: I really wish I was mistaken.
m500490.ふふ、心強い。\n――おっと、王子はちゃんと休んでおくんだよ。:
Heh, that's reassuring.
—Oh, right. Make sure you get some proper rest, Prince.
m500490.ほら、あちらに、\n魔界の住民さんたちが――:
Look, over there,
the residents of the Demon World are――
m500490.まさか、八つ当たりのように暴れまわるなんて……。: I can't believe he's rampaging like he's throwing a tantrum...
m500490.もちろん、今後も王子には\nがっつり出場してもらうからな！:
Of course, we're going to make sure
the Prince keeps competing hard from now on!
m500490.アガレスの影響でしょうか、\n敵の動きが、一段と速くなったような……！？:
Is it the influence of Agares?
The enemy's movements seem to have gotten even faster…!?
m500490.グシオンとその眷属は、\n傷を負うほど強くなります！\n皆さん、十分にご注意をー:
Gushion and his subordinates grow stronger
the more they're wounded!
Everyone, be extremely careful!
m500490.グシオンの闘気にアガレスがあてられたのか、\nアガレス復活にグシオンが引っ張られ:
Whether Agares was affected by Gushion's fighting spirit,
or Gushion was dragged into Agares's revival,
there's no way to know now――
m500490.タダでやられるつもりは無いみたいだねぇ。\nさすがは魔神アガレスといったところか:
He's not about to go down without a fight.
Truly befitting of the Demon God Agares.
m500490.ヤツもまだ、戦士であるはずだよ。\nならば、戦士の誇りをこれ以上汚す前に、\nあ:
He's still a warrior, after all.
We need to put him down before he stains that warrior's pride any further.
m500490.事実、ヤツの底しれない強さに惹かれて、\n一部のオークたちが暴れまわってる。\n:
In fact, some of the Orcs are being drawn to his immense strength
and are causing trouble themselves.
Looks like we'll have to put them down too.
m500490.今回の魔神討伐で、\nさらにファンが増えたんじゃないかい？:
With this Demon God subjugation,
didn't he gain even more fans?
m500490.他に、魔界闘技場を\n破壊した犯人がいるってことですか？: You're saying there's another culprit behind the destruction of the Demon Arena?
m500490.何しろ魔界の民はみんな、\n王子の戦いっぷりに惚れ込んじゃってるからさ。:
After all, everyone in the Demon World
is completely smitten with the way the Prince fights.
m500490.何らかの魔物の仕業でしょうか？: Could this be the work of some kind of monster?
m500490.傷を負うと素早くなるし、\n強くなっていくってことですか！？\nなんて厄介なー！:
So getting hit makes them faster
and stronger, is that it!?
What a pain!
m500490.分かるよグシオン、その怒り。\n楽しい戦いだったのに、\nアガレスに水を差された:
I understand, Gushion. That anger.
It was a fun fight, but you must think
Agares is trying to ruin it for you, right?
m500490.大事になる前に対処できて、なによりですね。: I'm so glad we were able to handle it before it got any worse.
m500490.悪いね、執務室で騒ぎ立てて。: My apologies for the ruckus in the office.
m500490.暴走した魔力も霧散しておる。\n一安心、といったところじゃな。:
The runaway magic is fading away as well.
I suppose we can breathe a sigh of relief.
m500490.殿下！ 魔神グシオンが再び立ち上がりました！\n体内の魔力が暴走状態になっていま:
Your Highness! Demon God Gushion has risen again!
The magic power inside him is going out of control!
m500490.王国からも調査団を派遣します。\n今後も異常が続く可能性は高いですから。:
We'll be sending an investigation team from the Kingdom as well.
There's a high chance these anomalies will continue.
m500490.王国の盟友たちと、\n歴代チャンプを讃える酒宴を開くぞ！！:
Let's throw a feast to honor our allies from the Kingdom
and the champions of the past!!
m500490.王子、あいつの最後の戦い、\n全力で相手をしてやりな。\nそれだけが、唯一のはな:
Prince, give him your all in his final battle.
That is the only proper way to see him off.
m500490.王子、やつが来る！\nこの周辺を荒らし回っていたのは……魔神アガレスだ！！:
Prince, he's coming!
The one who's been wreaking havoc in this area is... Demon God Agares!!
m500490.王子、王国からも討伐部隊を編成し、\n魔神グシオン征伐に向かいましょう。:
Prince, let's assemble an expeditionary force from the Kingdom
and head out to subdue the Demon God Gushion.
m500490.王子、魔神アガレスの魔力が暴走し始めました！: Prince, the Demon God Agares's magic is starting to run wild!
m500490.王子があいつの相手をしたことで、\nもう、あの魔神たちが苦しむことはなくなった。:
But because you faced him, Prince,
those Demon Gods will no longer suffer.
m500490.王子と激戦を繰り広げ、\n敗北を味わったことで\n満足そうに去っていった、あのグ:
That Gushion who fought the Prince to a bitter end,
tasted defeat,
and left looking satisfied...
m500490.王子に負けたことを認められず、\n暴れまわっているのでしょうか？: Is he rampaging because he can't accept his defeat at the Prince's hands?
m500490.現時点では断定することはできないですけど……。\n警戒しておくに越したことはあり:
We can't say for certain at this point, but...
It's better to be safe than sorry.
m500490.見事な防衛戦だったよ、王子。: That was a magnificent defense, Prince.
m500490.魔界闘技場が破壊された、とのことですが……。: You're saying the Demon Arena has been destroyed...
m500490.魔界闘技場が破壊されたって聞いて、\nブチギレちゃったのよ！\nもー！ 落ち着き:
She heard the Demon Arena was destroyed and just lost it!
Oh, come on! Calm down, will you!
m500490.魔界闘技場も再建が進んでいます。\n今後の大会にも影響は出ないようです。:
Reconstruction of the Demon Arena is progressing well.
It doesn't seem like it will affect any upcoming tournaments.
m500490.魔神の……！？\nそんな、グシオンは今ここに――:
A Demon God...!?
But how? Gushion is right here――
m500490.魔神の暴走がこれだけ続いているんだ。\nまだまだ、何が起きるかわからないからね。:
The Demon Gods have been rampaging for this long.
Who knows what else might happen.
m500490.魔神の魔力が共鳴しておる……！\n気をつけよ、両者の眷属が、グシオンと\nアガレ:
The magic power of the Demon Gods is resonating...!
Be careful. Their subordinates seem to be receiving
the blessings of both Gushion and Agares at the same time!
m500490.魔神を二体も相手したんだ。\n今は勝利の余韻ってやつを味わっておきな！:
You've faced two Demon Gods.
Soak in the afterglow of victory for a while!
m500490.魔神グシオン撃破！\n……いえ、そんな、こんなことが！？:
Demon God Gushion defeated!
…No, wait, what is this!?

m900483.――そういうわけで、カッコいい感じに仕上げてきたよ？: ――So, I went for a look that's cool, right?
m900483.――ところで王子、\nちょっとだけ、腹筋に触ってみても……？:
――By the way, Prince,
would it be okay if I just touched your abs for a second…?
m900483.――我が愛しき妹よ、その力を借りるぞ。\n風よ、風よ！ 星の大いなる力よ！\n今:
――My beloved sister, lend me your power.
Wind, wind! The great power of the stars!
Now, reveal its full might!!
m900483.――来たか。\n輝ける人類の英雄と、勇敢なる仲間たちよ。:
――So you've come.
Shining heroes of humanity, and your brave companions.
m900483.――生命の源よ！ 大地に注ぐ慈雨よ！\n我が戦士たちに癒しの力を与えよ！！:
――Source of life! Gentle rains that nourish the earth!
Grant my warriors the power of healing!!
m900483.――篝火を灯せ！ 砂塵を呼べ！\nこれなるは熱砂の試練である！！:
――Light the bonfires! Summon the dust!
This is the Trial of Scorching Sands!!
m900483.――見事なり、人類の英雄よ、勇敢なる戦士たちよ。: ――Well done, hero of humanity, and you, brave warriors.
m900483.…………受けて立とう。\n神獣ケツァルコアトル、全力でお相手する。:
…………I accept.
Divine Beast Quetzalcoatl, I will give you my full strength.
m900483.…………羽？\nリュウゼツランから、光る羽が出てきました！:
…………Feathers?
Glowing feathers are coming out of the Dragon's Breath!
m900483.……これは、断れない雰囲気ですね。: ……It feels like refusing would be impossible.
m900483.……まぁ、だろうな。よし、案内しよう。\n遠方の祭殿だが、信徒たちとは交流がある:
……Well, I suppose that's how it will be. Very well, let me guide you.
Though the Shrine is far away, we have connections with the believers there.
m900483.……ケツァルコアトル！\n生きる意志を、取り戻せましたか？:
……Quetzalcoatl!
Have you regained your will to live?
m900483.……王子に恋しちゃった？: ……Did she fall in love with the Prince?
m900483.「雨」が降り始めましたね……。\nこの「雨」が続く間、\n敵には癒しの加護がもた:
The "rain" has begun…
As long as this "rain" continues,
the enemies will be blessed with healing.
m900483.ああ、それも神獣本人からの果し状だ。: Yes, and it's a challenge from the Divine Beast herself.
m900483.あのぉ……ここにも喋る元神獣がいるのですが……。: Um… I mean, there's a former Divine Beast right here who can talk, too…
m900483.あの篝火から、呪力を感じるわ……！\n儀式で砂嵐を喚んでいるのね！？:
I can feel cursed energy emanating from those bonfires…!
They're using a ritual to summon the sandstorm, aren't they?!
m900483.あの輝く白い羽から、とんでもない魔力が\nケツァルコアトルへ流れ込んでいます！\:
An incredible amount of magical power is flowing
from those glowing white feathers into Quetzalcoatl!
It's dangerous to leave the feathers as they are!
m900483.あれはリュウゼツラン……！\n王国周辺では見られない植物です！:
That is an Agave…!
It is not native to the Kingdom!
m900483.いや……おそらくその断片じゃ。\n粉々に砕け散った力の残滓が、\n密林全土に広が:
No… it is likely merely a fragment.
The remnants of her shattered power
must have spread across the entire jungle.
m900483.うむ、いかにも。\n我が名はケツァルコアトル。\nかつては神の兵器であり、今は密:
Indeed.
I am Quetzalcoatl.
Once a weapon of the gods, I am now the guardian of this dense jungle.
m900483.うむ。\n同じ逸話が、我々の里だけでなく、\n密林全域にも伝わっている。:
Indeed.
The same legend is known not only in our village
but throughout the entire Dense Forest.
m900483.えぇっ、ずるい！\nそこは武具製作組が優先じゃないかなー！？:
Ehh, that's cheating!
Shouldn't the armor team get first dibs?!
m900483.えぇとぉ……差出人はぁ……。\nんんぅ、神獣ケツァルコアトル……？:
Um…… the sender is……
Hmm, Divine Beast Quetzalcoatl……?
m900483.えっ、えっと……確かに？\nそうだ、サイズ直ししないとね！:
Ehh, um… I guess so?
That's right, we need to adjust the fit!
m900483.おぉ、では今度こそ……！: Oh, then this time for sure…!
m900483.おぉぉ……。\nナイス腹筋、デリシャス大胸筋だぁ。:
Ohh…
Nice abs, and those delicious pecs.
m900483.おそらくあのトウモロコシが呪物であるはず。\n急いで破壊しちゃいましょう！:
That corn is likely the source of the curse.
Let's destroy it quickly!
m900483.お初にお目にかかります。\n神獣ケツァルコアトルさま、ですか……？:
It's a pleasure to meet you.
The Divine Beast Quetzalcoatl, is it…?
m900483.この温もりは……輝きは……。\nおぉ、おぉ……！ ケツァルペトラトル！\n我が愛:
This warmth… this radiance…
Oh, oh…! Quetzalpetlatl!
My beloved sister, you were here all along…!!
m900483.この雄大なる密林は、\n我が愛しき妹、ケツァルペトラトルが\n命を捨ててまで守り:
This magnificent jungle
was protected to the last breath by my beloved sister, Quetzalpetlatl.
It is, in a sense, her legacy.
m900483.これは飾りじゃない、戦う者のための装備だからね。\nケツァルコアトルの武具を纏う:
This isn't just decoration; it's equipment for a warrior.
When you don Quetzalcoatl's gear,
please change your title to "Bearer of the Winged Serpent."
m900483.これより王国の勇者たちを讃える、\n密林大宴会を始めようぞ！！: Let us now begin the Grand Feast of the Deep Jungle, to honor the heroes of the kingdom!
m900483.さすがに信徒の代筆だろう。\nだが、神獣ケツァルコアトルは、\n今この時代におい:
It's likely a scribe wrote it on her behalf.
But Quetzalcoatl is a great Divine Beast who retains her
self-awareness even in this age.
m900483.さて、真実は本人から聞くべきだろう。\nしかし王子も多忙な身の上だ。\n返事はよ:
Well, we should hear the truth from her directly.
But the Prince is a busy man.
He should think carefully before answering……
m900483.しかし、密林の多数の部族とも\n友好的な関係を築くことができました。:
However, we were able to build friendly relations
with the many tribes in the dense forest.
m900483.しゃべったぁぁぁぁ！？\nし、神獣が喋りましたよ！:
She's talking! She's actually talking!
D-Did the Divine Beast just speak?!
m900483.じゅるっ……くっ、\nケツァルコアトルめ、惑わしてくれる！:
*Slurp*… Grr,
You're trying to distract me, Quetzalcoatl!
m900483.すごい、神獣と対話できてるの、\nちょっと感動しちゃった。\nでも今は、それより:
Wow, we're actually conversing with a Divine Beast…
I'm a little moved, honestly.
But right now, what matters more is—
m900483.そこで王子よ、我が羽と鱗を譲ろう。\n我が権能の断片を宿した、魔力の塊だ。:
Therefore, Prince, I bequeath to you my feathers and scales.
They are masses of magical power imbued with fragments of my authority.
m900483.そしてケツァルコアトルは、\n妹が命をとして守った密林に舞い降り、\n今もその大:
And Quetzalcoatl descended into the Dense Forest
that her sister protected with her life,
and continues to guard that land to this day.
m900483.それだけじゃない……。\n篝火の呪力が、信徒の力も増しているみたい。:
It's not just that…
The cursed energy from the bonfires seems to be boosting the believers' power, too.
m900483.そんな偉大な神獣さまが、どうして王子に果し状を？\n手を貸してくれるとかなら分か:
Why would such a great Divine Beast send a challenge to the Prince?
If she were offering her help, I could understand……
m900483.つまり、篝火を破壊すれば、\nこの呪術的現象も止まるってことだね。\n王子、優先: So, if we destroy the bonfires, this cursed phenomenon will stop. Prince, let's make destroying them our top priority.
m900483.ですからあれは呪物なんです！\n誰かレギーナさんを押さえててください！:
I'm telling you, it's a cursed object!
Someone hold Regina down!
m900483.ですが、この密林そのものが、\nケツァルペトラトルの生きた証ではありませんか！:
But isn't this jungle itself
proof that Quetzalpetlatl lived?
m900483.では、あとは部隊の編成だけですね。\nケツァルコアトルは神獣ですから、\n「神の:
Then all that's left is forming the party.
Since Quetzalcoatl is a Divine Beast,
she should possess the power of "Divine Radiance."
m900483.では、果たし合いに挑む方々の選抜が終わり次第、\nジャングルへ出発しましょう！:
Then, once the selection of those who will take on the duel is complete,
let's set off for the jungle!
m900483.では我が信徒たちよ！\n近隣の里の者らも呼んで参れ！:
Then, my faithful ones!
Summon the people of the nearby villages!
m900483.では王子よ、我が戦いの誘い、返答をもらおうか。: Then, Prince, I shall await your answer to my challenge.
m900483.でも、ケツァルペトラトルは千年戦争の最中、\n大規模な破壊魔法から人類を守るため:
However, Quetzalpetlatl sacrificed her life
to shield humanity from a massive destructive spell
during the height of the Millennium War……
m900483.とはいえ、この祭殿から離れられぬのもまた事実。\n貴様らの戦いに、助力するのは難:
That said, it is a fact that I cannot leave this sanctuary.
It will be difficult for me to assist in your battles.
m900483.ともあれ、此度の戦い、お疲れ様でした！: In any case, well done on this battle!
m900483.なっ……なななっ、なんだと！？\nトウモロコシが生えてきたぞ！！:
Wha… wh-what is this?!
Corn is growing!
m900483.なるほど……ふふふ、口の上手い小娘が。\nよかろう、ならばこれより先は手を抜かぬ:
I see… heh heh, what a silver-tongued little girl.
Very well. From here on, I will hold nothing back.
Let me show you my true power!
m900483.はっはっは。\nならばいざ、力比べを始めよう！:
Hahahaha!
Then let us begin this test of strength!
m900483.はははっ、愉快な子らだ。\n確か、千年戦争の時の、あの男が作った国だったか？\n:
Hahaha, what a charming group you are.
I recall, from the time of the Millennium War… that nation was founded by that man, was it not?
The Kingdom seems to be a truly fine place.
m900483.ふぅ……死にそうな雰囲気なんて全然ないのに、\nこの身はもう長くないなんて言いだ:
Phew… There was no sign at all that you were about to die,
yet you kept saying your days were numbered.
You really had us worried, Quetzalcoatl.
m900483.ふん、小娘に心配されるほど老いぼれてはおらぬわ。\nこの密林は、これからも我が守:
Hmph. I'm not so decrepit that I need a little girl's concern.
I must continue to protect this dense forest!
m900483.ほう……。\nよし、王子、今すぐ着てみろ。:
Hm…
Very well, Prince. Try it on right now.
m900483.まさか……千年戦争で消滅したはずの、\nケツァルペトラトルが、生きていたってこと:
No way… you mean Quetzalpetlatl,
who should have perished in the Millennium War, is still alive?
m900483.まさか、神獣の直筆……？: Could it be…… in the Divine Beast's own handwriting?
m900483.やれやれ……困った神獣だよ。\nでも、生きる気力を取り戻してくれてよかった。:
Oh, you're a troublesome divine beast.
But I'm glad you've regained your will to live.
m900483.よし、リュウゼツランを破壊したぞ！: Right, the Dragon's Breath is destroyed!
m900483.ん……んん……。\nケツァルコアトル、長くないと言いましたが――:
Hm… Hmm…
Quetzalcoatl, you said your days are numbered, but—
m900483.ジャングルまでの移動は私にまかせてください。\n兵装は換装中ですが、\n移動手段:
Leave the travel to the jungle to me.
My equipment is currently being swapped out,
but as a means of transport, I am the fastest in the world!
m900483.パルセも、ユニコーンだった時、\n結構相手するの大変だったよ？:
Paruse, even when you were a Unicorn,
you were quite a handful to deal with, weren't you?
m900483.リュウゼツランがある限り、この「強風」は止まらない！\nこのままだと攻防両方に悪:
As long as that Agave remains, this "gale" won't stop!
If we don't act, it will hinder both our offense and defense!
m900483.兄たるケツァルコアトル、\n妹たるケツァルペトラトルは、\n巨大なる体躯をもって:
The elder brother, Quetzalcoatl,
and the younger sister, Quetzalpetlatl,
fought the horde of monsters with their massive bodies.
m900483.千年戦争時に負った傷のために、\n祭殿から離れることこそ叶わぬそうだが、\n今も:
Due to the wounds she sustained during the Millennium War,
she is said to be unable to leave the Shrine,
but she continues to protect the people from monsters even now.
m900483.家族を亡くし、生きる意志も失ったあなたは、\n王子にすべてを譲って消えようと考え:
You lost your family and your will to live,
and decided to hand everything to the Prince and fade away, didn't you?
m900483.密林の諸部族では、武力や財力以上に、\nその魂のあり方を重要視する。\n密林の戦:
Among the tribes of the dense forest, the state of one's soul is valued above all else, even above martial prowess or wealth.
The warriors of the forest have accepted the Prince.
m900483.御身は千年戦争において、深手を負ったと聞く。\nならば、その命を削ってまで、\n:
I've heard you were grievously wounded during the Millennium War.
If that's the case, why do you seek a duel with us,
even at the cost of your own life?
m900483.我が試練とは、即ち大地と空、自然を司るもの。\n王子よ、見事乗り越えてみせるがよ: My trial is the domain of the earth and the sky, of nature itself. Prince, show me how you overcome it!
m900483.木々にも、花にも、\nケツァルペトラトルの\n断片が宿っておったということじゃな:
The trees, the flowers…
fragments of Quetzalpetlatl
must have dwelt within them.
m900483.未来をこの手で守り続けられぬのならば、\nその前に、我が力を託すに相応しい者に、:
If I can no longer protect the future with my own hands,
I decided to entrust my power to someone worthy,
along with the future of the jungle itself.
m900483.本当は、もっと鎧っぽくしようかなって思ったんだけど、\nぜひともこういうデザイン:
I was originally thinking of making it more armor-like,
but the people in the dense forest really, really insisted on this design, so…
m900483.此度の遠征は、神獣の力を授かっただけでなく、\n王国の未来のためにも、\nとても:
This expedition was not only a chance to receive the divine beast's power,
but I believe it was a crucial battle
for the future of the Kingdom.
m900483.武具の方も神獣の鱗製だからね。\n王子、相当ケツァルコアトルに気に入られたっぽい:
The armor is made from the divine beast's scales, too.
It seems Quetzalcoatl really took a liking to you, Prince.
It was packed with so much magical power that it was a pain to work with.
m900483.死期を悟ったのか、\n王子の実力を試したいのか……。\nうぅん……今までの神獣の:
Has she sensed her end is near,
or does she wish to test the Prince's strength……
Hmm…… looking back on the other Divine Beasts we've met――
m900483.火よ、水よ、風よ！\n密林に満ちるすべての力よ！\n神獣ケツァルコアトルの、呼び:
Fire, water, wind!
All the power that fills this jungle!
Answer the call of the Divine Beast Quetzalcoatl!!
m900483.王国軍として、挑まれた戦いから逃げるつもりはない。\nでも、ひとつ聞いていいかな:
We won't back down from a challenge issued to the Kingdom's army.
But may I ask you something?
m900483.王子、ケツァルコアトルは\nケツァルペトラトルの権能を借りたみたいだ。: Prince, it seems Quetzalcoatl is borrowing the power of Quetzalpetlatl.
m900483.王子！ ドーンブリンガーの観測装置が、\n『砂嵐』の接近を感知しました！:
Prince! The Doonbringer's observation device
has detected a sandstorm approaching!
m900483.相手は魔物の軍勢を薙ぎ払った神獣ですから、\nこちらも大総力戦編成で挑むべきでし:
Our opponent is a Divine Beast who swept away monster armies,
so we should challenge her with a full-force formation.
m900483.確かに、密林の男たちからも、\n激しい戦いと飲みっぷりのおかげで、\n王子も一目:
Indeed, the men of the dense forest seem to hold the Prince in high regard,
thanks to the fierce battles and his impressive drinking.
m900483.神獣ケツァルコアトルといえば、\n千年戦争での逸話が有名ですね。:
Speaking of Quetzalcoatl,
the legends from the Millennium War are quite famous.
m900483.結構野性味あふれる感じになったんじゃないかなー。: It's got quite a wild edge to it, don't you think?
m900483.落ち着いてください！\nあれは呪物ですから、食用じゃないですよ！:
Please stay calm!
That is a cursed object, not food!
m900483.貴様、ユニコーンだな？\n今は黙っておれ。:
You're a Unicorn, aren't you?
Hold your tongue for now.
m900483.食用にもできますし、\nあれでお酒を作る地域もあるそうですよ。:
It is edible, actually.
In some regions, they even make liquor from it.
m900483.鱗は強力無比なる武具に、\n羽はその身を守る装束に使うがよい。:
Use the scales to forge weapons of unmatched power,
and the feathers for garments that will protect your body.

m920015.あたしの力はまだこんな物じゃない……\n次こそは勝つ！: My power isn't meant for something this weak… Next time I'll win!
m920015.あの娘は獣人のようです。\n人と魔物の中間……\nどちらでもあり……どちらでもな: She seems to be a beastfolk—half human, half monster… both and neither.
m920015.おまえが人間たちを率いる\n英雄の末裔か……。: So you're the descendant of the hero who leads the humans…
m920015.おまえを……おまえを倒せば！: If I… if I defeat you!
m920015.この数日、民たちが森の狼の襲撃を\n受けることが多発しています。: These past few days, the villagers have been repeatedly attacked by wolves from the forest.
m920015.さすがは多くの魔物たちを倒しただけはある。\nだからこそ、おまえを倒すことができ: You've proven yourself by slaying countless monsters. That's why, if I can defeat you, I'll prove the beastfolk's strength!
m920015.そのため獣人は人里から離れ\nひっそりと暮らしていることが\n多いのですが: Because of that, beastfolk often keep to themselves, away from villages…
m920015.どうやら魔物たちに組しているようです。\nお気をつけください！: It looks like she's allied with the monsters. Be careful!
m920015.やはり、彼らは人間の敵になってしまう\nのでしょうか……。: So, I guess they'll become our enemies after all…
m920015.中には森から遠く離れた居住地まで\n被害が及んでおります。\n何か良くないことが: Some of the damage has even reached settlements far from the woods. Something bad might be happening…
m920015.人間と獣人どちらが生き残るのか\nここで決着をつけようか！: Human or beastfolk, who will survive? Let's settle it here and now!
m920015.狼は獣人が操っていたようですね。: It appears the wolves were being controlled by the beastfolk.
m920015.獣人たちは人間を憎んでいると聞きます。\n人間の中には獣人を魔物の手先として\n: I've heard beastfolk despise humans. Many humans look down on them as monsters' pawns…
m920015.獣人は人からさげすまれ……\n魔物からは軽んじられる……\nお前を倒して、あたし: Beastfolk are scorned by humans… despised by monsters… I'll defeat you and prove our strength!
m920015.王子、夜は人狼の力が増します。\nお気をつけください。: Prince, the werewolves grow stronger at night. Be careful.
m920015.私たちは獣人をさげすんでなんていません。\nどうか話をきいてください。: We don't look down on beastfolk. Please, hear us out.
m920015.闇は魔物の味方だ。\n人間たちには負けない！: Darkness sides with monsters. We won't lose to humans!

m920022.……あの、私も共に戦います。\nただ剣の力が完全に戻ったわけでは\nないので、ど: …Um, I'll fight alongside you. My sword's power isn't fully restored, so I'm not sure how much I can contribute…
m920022.……とはいえ、刻水晶を集めると\nいってもどうしたらよいのでしょうか。: …That said, even if we need to collect crystal shards, how are we supposed to do it?
m920022.「竜殺しの剣」は、わが王家に代々伝わる聖剣で、\nかつて竜を倒したといわれていま: The “Dragon-slayer Sword” is a holy blade passed down through my royal family, said to have slain a dragon once.
m920022.あれは水竜！\n水竜の泡のブレスに気をつけてください！:
That's a water dragon!
Watch out for its bubbling breath!
m920022.えーっと……。\nそれって、私たちを食べにくるってことですか。:
Um…
Does that mean it's coming to eat us?
m920022.おそらく無理かと思われます。\n人間に好意的な竜も、例外として\nこの世のどこか:
I doubt it's possible.
I've heard that even dragons friendly to humans are rare, but they exist somewhere.
m920022.ここが竜のねぐらのようです。\n強力な竜の気配を感じます。:
This must be the dragon's lair.
I can feel a strong draconic presence.
m920022.この剣は竜の牙を鍛えて作り出したもの。\n再び力を取り戻すためには刻水晶を集め\: This sword was forged from a dragon's fang. To restore its power we must gather crystal shards and re-empower it.
m920022.この地にはどんな竜がいるのですか？: What kind of dragon lives in this place?
m920022.この地には火竜が住むといわれています。\n火竜の炎はかなりの範囲を巻き込む威力を:
They say a fire dragon dwells here.
Its flames are said to cover a huge area with tremendous power.
m920022.この感じ……きます！\nあれは……黒竜！？:
I can feel it… it's coming!
Is that… a black dragon?!
m920022.この感じ、近くに竜の気配を感じます。\nそれにどうやらこちらに向かって\nきてい:
I'm sensing a dragon nearby…
It looks like it's heading straight for us.
m920022.この竜殺しの剣さえ使えれば\nいいのですが……。: If only we could make use of the Dragon-slayer Sword…
m920022.しかし、大抵は人間をエサとしてしか\n見ていませんから……。\n竜を倒して奪うほ:
However, most see humans only as food…
So we'll have to slay a dragon and take them.
m920022.そうですか。では、これから竜を探しにいくと\nいうわけですね。:
I see.
So we're going to hunt for a dragon now.
m920022.その瞬間から、剣から力が消え失せてしまいました。\nそして、剣の持ち手も命を落と: From that moment, the sword lost its power, and its wielder also perished…
m920022.それに、ここには毒が立ち込めています。\n長い戦闘は我々には不利。\n一気に仕掛: Also, poison fills this place. A long battle would be to our disadvantage. Let's strike all at once!
m920022.それに加えて魔法に対しても\n高い耐性を備えています。: And they're highly resistant to magic, too.
m920022.それはこちらとしては都合が良いですが、\n何をしにくるのでしょうか。:
That works in our favor, but…
What do you think it wants?
m920022.ただ、水竜の鱗は他の竜よりも脆いはず。\n物理攻撃が比較的有効です。:
Still, a water dragon's scales are thinner than other dragons'. 
Physical attacks are relatively effective.
m920022.ただし、竜は飛んでいるときこそ空から一方的に\n攻撃できますが、ここは地下の洞窟: While a dragon can be attacked from the sky when it's flying, this is an underground cavern.
m920022.ですが、あの黒竜の硬い鱗を打ち破るのに\n役に立つかもしれません。: But I might be useful for breaking that black dragon's hard scales.
m920022.ですが、ある強い力を持つ魔物と戦った際、\n魔物は断末魔と共に剣に呪いをかけまし: But when we fought a particularly strong monster, it cursed the sword as it died.
m920022.どうやらもう一度戦わなければ\nならないようですね。: It seems we'll have to fight again.
m920022.な、なるほど。\n王子、正攻法が有効とのことです。\n勝利を信じております！: I—I see. Prince, a straightforward attack should work. I believe we'll win!
m920022.なるほど黒竜ですか。\n黒竜の弱点を教えてください。:
I see, a black dragon.
Tell us its weakness.
m920022.はぁ、、はぁ、、ここが、女神アイギスの神殿。\nようやくたどり着けました……。\:
Haa… haa… this is the Temple of the goddess Aegis.
We finally made it…
Is anyone… anyone there?
m920022.はい。\n樹海に住むという竜の元へ行きます。:
Yes.
We'll go to the dragon that lives in the forest.
m920022.わかりました。\n竜殺しと呼ばれた剣、完全ではなくとも\n何かしらの力を発揮して: Understood. The sword called “Dragon-slayer,” even if it's not complete, may still unleash some power.
m920022.エルフの里が魔物の襲撃を受けているようです！: It seems the Elf Village is under monster attack!
m920022.ヤッと追いツイタ。\n竜殺しノ剣ヲ奪エ！:
We finally caught up.
We'll take the Dragon-slayer Sword!
m920022.一発の威力は低いですが\nまとまって飛んでくるのでとても危険です。: Each blast is weak, but they come in clusters and are very dangerous.
m920022.今回黒竜は、空を自由に飛ぶことができます。\n前回よりも厳しい戦いになります。: This time the black dragon can fly freely in the sky. It'll be a tougher battle than before.
m920022.先ほどのような翼竜も刻水晶を持っていますが\n力はとても弱いです。: Even the wyvern we just faced carries crystal shards, but its power is very weak.
m920022.先ほどの魔物たちの増援でしょう。\n王子、出撃のご準備を！:
It must be reinforcements from those monsters earlier.
Prince, prepare to deploy!
m920022.先ほどの魔物たちは、この「竜殺しの剣」を狙って\n追ってきた魔物……。: The monsters we just faced were after the “Dragon-slayer Sword”—they were chasing it.
m920022.剣の力を取り戻すためにはもっと\n力の強い刻水晶が必要です。: To restore the sword's power we need much stronger crystal shards.
m920022.力の強い刻水晶ですか。\n事情を話せば分けてくれるでしょうか？:
Stronger crystal shards, huh?
If we explain the situation, will they share them with us?
m920022.助けていただき、ありがとうございます。\n私はクローディアと申します。\n遠く離:
Thank you for saving me.
My name is Claudia.
I fled here from a distant foreign land.
m920022.地下にいた黒竜一匹だけだと\n思っていたのに……。: I thought there was only that one black dragon down here…
m920022.敵襲、敵襲！\n魔物の軍勢が現れました。\nさあ、あなたは神殿の中へ！:
Enemy attack! Enemy attack!
A horde of monsters has appeared.
Now, you head into the temple!
m920022.敵襲！ 敵襲！\nこちらに敵が向かってきている模様です！:
Enemy attack! Enemy attack!
It looks like they're heading straight for us!
m920022.気をつけてください。\nドラゴンの硬い鱗は生半可な刃を通しません。:
Be careful.
A dragon's hard scales won't be pierced by ordinary blades.
m920022.気をつけてください。\n竜は二匹います！:
Be on guard.
There are two dragons!
m920022.王子、ここはクローディアさんにも\n一緒に戦ってもらいましょう。: Prince, let's have Claudia join us in this fight.
m920022.王子、どうか力をお貸しください！\nこの剣の持ち手であった兄の意思を継いで\n戦: Prince, please lend me your strength! I need it to carry on my brother's will, the sword's former bearer, and keep fighting…!
m920022.王子、灼熱の砂漠を行軍している影響で\n兵たちの体力も下がっています。\nお気を:
Prince, marching through this scorching desert is draining the troops' stamina.
Please be careful.
m920022.確かに。\nそれならこちらにも……。:
Indeed.
Then we have the… advantage as well.
m920022.竜が現れました！\n自由に飛ばれては、不利です。\n翼を攻撃して地上に落としてく:
A dragon has appeared!
If it flies freely, we'll be at a disadvantage.
Strike its wings and bring it down!
m920022.竜の方は自由に飛ぶことができません。\nですので、こちらが不利というわけではあり: The dragon can't fly freely here, so we're not at a disadvantage.
m920022.竜殺しの剣が竜の気配を感知しています。\n強い竜が迫ってきているようです！:
The Dragon-slayer Sword is picking up a dragon's presence.
A powerful dragon is approaching!
m920022.竜殺しの剣が震えている……。\n一匹ではないの！？:
The Dragon-slayer Sword is trembling…
